results.title: Star of the Sea - The Football, the Troubles and the Aftermath
results.original_title: Réalt na Mara - An Peil, Na Triblóidí agus an Iarmhairt
results.overview: In 1960s Belfast, Star of the Sea was one of Ireland’s most successful youth football teams, bringing Catholic and Protestant players together at a time of growing division. But as the Troubles took hold, the team was torn apart and the lives of its players changed forever.

results.title: Retuning
results.overview: In 2024, a major political shift in Slovakia triggers a radical, aggressive restructuring of the country's independent public service media law. Filming directly from within the hallways and newsrooms of the national broadcaster (RTVS), debut director Sára Prokopová captures the volatile transition as the channel is forcefully dismantled and rebranded into the state-controlled STVR.  Amid an atmosphere of deep uncertainty, mounting political pressure, and creeping censorship, a group of resilient journalists forms an internal strike committee to defend the integrity of their profession. What begins as an absurd bureaucratic shift quickly unfolds into a tragic reality: independent journalism is curtailed, opposition voices are muted, and the institution itself begins to be run by political appointees lacking expertise—some of whom openly speculate on air about whether the Earth is flat.

results.title: Love, Acting
results.overview: In the late-night streets of Yokohama, Japan, a male prostitute encounters a film director. He boldly offers himself for an audition, only to be confronted with the haunting question: "What is love?" In the heart of downtown Tokyo, a same-sex couple who have been together for seven years find the spark in their relationship fading. They decide to invite a third person to join them, unaware that the arrival of this mysterious stranger will irrevocably transform their lives. Inside an adult cinema, a "money boy" in the back row meets a middle-aged married man in the front. Their transaction carries a hidden undercurrent of danger. In the vast expanse of the city, these young men are struggling to survive, wavering in their pursuit of affection. But in the end, what does true love really mean?

results.title: The Flight of Butterflies
results.overview: The Flight of Butterflies is a documentary about Dariush, a 22-year-old autistic young man, exploring his everyday life, his work, and his personal dreams. Through quiet observations and intimate encounters, the film reflects on individuality, human potential, and the ways people seek to express themselves in a world that often struggles to understand them.
